systems.name: 2.1 Spline-Based Track Generator
systems.notes: Built. tools/spline-editor.html draws closed Catmull-Rom loops with per-control-point width/bank/elevation and exports kind:"spline-track" JSON to assets/3D/maps/ (manifest.json → hydrateLevels()). The SAME sampled spline drives physics (racer/track.js) and rendering (racer/trackrender.js); ramp segments + per-CP width/bank included. 4 playable courses: AHURA RING (procedural), MY TRACK, HILL TEST, BANK TEST.
tasks: Varying width, banking, and elevation — done
Segment types: straight, curve, hairpin, chicane — done (CP-driven)
Export to track data format shared by physics + renderer — done

systems.name: 2.2 Environment & Biome Decor
systems.notes: Built: solid/non-solid wall runs, destructible tire-stack barriers on open stretches (racer/tirestacks.js), pine billboard trees (racer/scenery.js), and the fuji parallax sky (racer/sky.js). Missing: track-side cones, direction signs, start/finish + checkpoint markers, streetlamps, and the per-biome texture swap (tokens + placeholder textures planned under 2.4).
tasks: Track-side barrier rails and cones — barrier rails done, cones missing
Direction signs and checkpoint markers — missing
Streetlamps — missing (neon glow dropped with Phase 4 kart split)
Biome integration: desert, city (day/night), volcano — tokens + floor texture placeholders via 2.4

systems.name: 2.3 Track Hazards & Obstacles
systems.notes: Deferred alongside the Phase 4 removal — no kart power-ups. Boost already comes from drift tiers, ramps, and flips. Soft barriers exist (tire stacks). Remaining candidates: oil slicks, non-kart boost pads, moving obstacles.
tasks: Boost pad trigger with speed multiplier

systems.name: 2.4 Track Environment via Island-Gen Builders (DEFERRED → Phase 5)
systems.notes: Locked plan, NOT built. Deferred to prioritize head2head/splitscreen (5.2). Repurpose game/world.js island/Voronoi generation into per-level terrain: seeded block-shape builders (slab/pillar/stepped/L/ledge/column/trapezoid/tri-prism/crescent/cross) plus ported island/mountain GLB rocks, placed in Voronoi rings around the track's bounding shape, collidable via AABB push-out in vehicle.js (horizontal only, height-gated so jumps clear), staying clear of the drivable band. New per-biome token in the spline editor + level JSON: grass (default) / desert / city_day / city_night / volcano → floor textures (placeholder grass/sand/volcanic/rock/dirt, swappable for photosourced uploads). No sky tinting.
tasks: Port island-gen block builders + seeded Voronoi-ring placement around track bounds
Collidable AABB push-out in vehicle.js (wall-bounce feel, jump-over gated)
Per-biome token: spline editor field + level JSON + levels.js fallback
